title: LADA Y vs Strange Brews, Oct 26
notes: Home game at Kirkland against Strange Brews: we wore white on the home bench right of center, the Brews red. The video is LiveBarn's late 3438x1374 upload under a thin black band, 54 px low once scaled up; fetch shifted it into Kirkland's usual framing before detection.

Periods from the arena scoreboard's clock: 0:09-18:31, 20:19-38:56 and 40:33-66:27 of the video. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd; the video reaches the final horn. Hilfer #31 was in our net, the right one in the 1st and 3rd, the left in the 2nd.

Who played: 12 skaters, as the sheet has them. Belousenko wore #13 (his usual #11 sat), listed here as a sub under #13. Didn't play: Sokolov #4, Belousenko's #11, Beregovoy #67 and #87, Mischenko #72, Podkorytov #82 and Olyanich #89. Three players share the nameplate LISITSYN (#32, #70, #83); they were told apart by number.

Goals from SportNinja's game sheet, placed in the video and checked by eye: 7:11 (clock 10:49, 1st, Strange Brews' #88 Thompson from #14), 14:38 (3:31, #78 Shakhov from #12 and #70, on the power play), 23:03 (15:15, 2nd, #70 Lisitsyn, shorthanded), 25:20 (13:01, #13 Belousenko from #97), 27:21 (10:59, Strange Brews' #15 Humphries from #27 and #6), 28:33 (9:43, #83 Lisitsyn from #97 and #32), 36:23 (1:57, Strange Brews' #14 Moroney), 38:08 (0:14, Strange Brews' #19 Lipavsky from #27), 44:41 (14:46, 3rd, #78 Shakhov), 48:15 (12:26, Strange Brews' #27 Deyo on a breakaway) and 49:50 (11:18, Strange Brews' #27 Deyo). Final 5-6. The scorers of the 1-1 and 4-2 goals couldn't be read in the scrambles; the page keeps the sheet's credits.

Penalty kills, from the whistle to the player leaving the box: Akulov #37 20:40-24:17 (tripping; the sheet's time is when the panel started, not the whistle), Ber #14 54:30-57:44 (tripping), Lisitsyn #70 56:11-58:54 (slashing; with Ber's, 3 on 5 for about 1:30) and Yafunyaev #29 63:56 to the horn (body checking). Strange Brews' #6 went to the box at 13:40 for hooking (not the sheet's 6:07) and Shakhov's goal came on that power play. Our goalie stayed in to the end.

Lineups were checked by eye: 32 on/off spans fix line changes the tracker missed, one of them added from a checker's notes. Lisitsyn #83's 6:27 shift in the 3rd, through both of the overlapping kills, is real.

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 10:49: Strange Brews' #88 Thompson from #14, fed from the corner into a scramble at our crease, 0-1
1st period, clock 3:31: on the power play, Shakhov shoots from the high slot and it goes in off the scramble, 1-1
2nd period, clock 15:15: shorthanded, Lisitsyn #70 strips the puck at the top of the circle and goes in alone, 2-1
2nd period, clock 13:01: Belousenko carries in from the slot and scores out of a short scramble, 3-1
2nd period, clock 10:59: Strange Brews' #15 Humphries from #27 and #6, tapped in at the far post, 3-2
2nd period, clock 9:43: Lisitsyn #83 out of a pile at their crease, 4-2
2nd period, clock 1:57: Strange Brews' #14 Moroney, jammed in at the post after a drive, 4-3
2nd period, clock 0:14: Strange Brews' #19 Lipavsky from #27, poked in at the post, 4-4
3rd period, clock 14:46: Shakhov carries wide, cuts across the slot and shoots, 5-4
3rd period, clock 12:26: Strange Brews' #27 Deyo on a breakaway from our blue line, 5-5
3rd period, clock 11:18: Strange Brews' #27 Deyo, jammed in at our goalie in a pile, 5-6
